# Appy Pie

> Appy Pie is an AI-powered no-code platform that enables anyone to create native mobile apps and websites without coding, with support for iOS, Android, and web publishing.

Appy Pie provides a comprehensive suite of no-code tools for app and website development, featuring AI-driven generators, drag-and-drop builders, and industry-specific templates for restaurants, delivery services, taxi booking, churches, and eCommerce. The platform supports publishing to Google Play Store and Apple App Store with integrated payment processing, push notifications, and advanced features like GPS tracking and online ordering.

## AI-Powered Generators

- [AI App Generator — Free No-Code App Generator | Appy Pie](https://www.appypie.com/ai-app-generator): Free AI app generator creating native iOS and Android apps from text.
- [Free AI Website Builder — Create Your Website in Minutes](https://www.appypie.com/ai-website-builder): AI website builder creating SEO-optimized sites from text descriptions.
- [AI No-Code Platform to Turn Prompt to Apps & Websites](https://www.appypie.com): Appy Pie's AI no-code platform converts prompts to apps and websites.

## Mobile App Builders

- [App Maker | No-Code App Builder for Android & iOS | Appy Pie](https://www.appypie.com/app-builder/appmaker): No-code app maker for native Android and iOS app development.
- [Android App Builder — Create Android Apps Without Coding](https://www.appypie.com/android-app-builder): No-code Android app builder with Google Play Store publishing.
- [iPhone App Builder – Create iOS Apps Without Coding](https://www.appypie.com/iphone-app-builder): iOS app builder for creating and publishing iPhone apps to App Store.
- [Convert Website to Mobile App (Android & iOS) | Appy Pie](https://www.appypie.com/convert-website-to-mobile-apps): Convert websites into native Android and iOS apps without coding.
- [Convert Website to APK (Android) | Appy Pie Free APK Maker](https://www.appypie.com/convert-website-to-apk): Website to APK converter for Android app creation and publishing.

## Website Builder

- [Website Builder - Create a Free Website in Minutes | Appy Pie](https://www.appypie.com/website-builder): Drag-and-drop website builder with SEO tools and mobile responsiveness.

## Industry-Specific App Builders

- [Ecommerce App Builder to Create an Online Store App](https://www.appypie.com/e-commerce-app-builder): No-code eCommerce app builder with payment integration and inventory.
- [Restaurant App Builder | Create a Restaurant App for Free](https://www.appypie.com/restaurant-app-maker): Restaurant app builder with online ordering and loyalty programs.
- [Delivery App Builder to Create Food Delivery App for Free](https://www.appypie.com/on-demand-delivery-app-builder): Delivery app builder for food, grocery, and package delivery apps.
